scope: 本地设计图片跨项目资产选择；无服务器部署或 Git 推送
implementation: 默认全部可访问项目，项目筛选位于搜索工具栏，卡片显示来源项目
当前会话输入从有读权限来源的已入库图片复制；目标项目写权限和会话归属不放宽
来源版本元数据、私有目标副本、同会话重复选图复用、数据库失败对象清理
原图与来源项目不改动，副本默认不进入资产中心，沿用现有草稿、遮罩和任务契约
参数抽屉和实时图片来源复用相同策略，其他未传入项目目录的选择器保持原范围

validation.integration: 7 isolated PostgreSQL/MinIO groups passed; includes byte-identical copied object, private preview, repeated import, target input resolution and real job submission; source/target access and unsaved image rejection
browser: CUA: default all projects lists saved images from both fixture projects
CUA: source project filter displays only selected project images
CUA: selected image from other project enters current conversation
CUA: browser refresh restores the imported image and keeps current project/conversation
validation.static: changed-scope Oxfmt, ESLint (existing test stub warnings), type-aware Oxlint, Stylelint and diff checks
validation.environment: random isolated databases and buckets; CPU image fixtures; no inference Worker and no new GPU jobs
validation.setupNotes: 基础设施最初未启动；启动既有开发基础设施后重测。单测修正了按钮更新等待和 Alert 测试替身；集成修正了内联假图片、权限状态码和测试项目对首页统计的影响，未放宽生产校验。首次浏览器刷新遇测试进程已退出，重建独立测试环境后刷新成功；沿用旧测试 Cookie 启动时记录 refresh-token 失效，重新登录后业务操作未新增运行错误。

compatibility.priorUncommittedFixes: preserved; included in current full unit and build checks
